overview: The Affordable Housing Trust Fund Board executed its Declaration of Trust, reviewed progress on the Housing Action Plan and potential funding streams, and received an extensive briefing from Planning Department staff on citywide zoning updates and major redevelopment projects.

items.title: Declaration of Trust Execution
items.summary: Board members signed the Declaration of Trust before a notary to enable recording at the Registry of Deeds.

items.title: Housing Action Plan Working Group Update
items.summary: The working group reported on input from stakeholder focus groups with regional service providers and discussed scheduling an upcoming public listening session.

items.title: Funding and Technical Assistance Updates
items.summary: Staff reviewed upcoming City Council hearings for Community Preservation Act funding and technical assistance from CHAPA, while Mayor Lungo-Koehn reported on potential future revenues from city parcel sales and institutional agreements.

items.title: Planning, Development and Sustainability Department Updates
items.summary: Planning Director Alicia Hunt and staff presented updates on the comprehensive zoning overhaul schedule, proposed incentive and inclusionary zoning tables with fractional cash-in-lieu options, and active RFP proposals for Medford Square and the Wellington area.
